'''Squadron Members''' were Decipher's volunteer promoters for ''Star Wars'' CCG from 1996 to 2001.<ref name="decsq-hegyi">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/hegyipaul.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 18 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991221072943/http://www.decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/hegyipaul.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="decsq-sommerfeld">[http://decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/sommerfeldwinfried.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 41], decipher.com (page last modified 28 June 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001023104822/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/sommerfeldwinfried.html Internet Archive]</ref> They ran tournaments and demos and helped local players.<ref name="slack-ming-2026">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Ming Huo (mingtown), 9 October 2026. "basically a volunteer that helped decipher coordinate events."</ref><ref name="decsq-index">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/index.html Volunteers: Star Wars CCG Squadrons], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010211005200/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Squadrons ==

Members were numbered within the Red, Gold, Rogue and Bravo squadrons. Each squadron's leader was a Decipher employee: Red Leader [[Jonathan Quesenberry]], Gold Leader [[Kendrick Summers]], Rogue Leader [[Kyle Heuer]] and Bravo Leader [[Kevin Reitzel]].<ref name="fan-roster">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas; mirror [https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/ oocities.org]; originally geocities.com/plarathas and geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433). Preserved copies: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive] (geocities.ws); [https://web.archive.org/web/20160409152825/http://reocities.com/collegepark/plaza/9433/SMs.html Internet Archive] (reocities, 2016); [https://web.archive.org/web/20010513005725/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/ Internet Archive] (original GeoCities home, 2001)</ref><ref name="pc-reprint">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/decipher-swccg-squadron-members/ Decipher SWCCG Squadron Members], starwarsccg.org (Players Committee, 1 July 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261025162059/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/decipher-swccg-squadron-members.html Internet Archive].</ref>

'''FL''' marks a '''Flight Leader''', a key volunteer who worked more directly with Decipher.<ref name="slack-ming-2026" /><ref name="slack-lingrell-2026">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Scott Lingrell, 9 October 2026. "They were a step up from a normal volunteer"; "It wasn't really ranked higher, but they were just key volunteers that would be more involved directly with decipher"; "Also, it's not complete. I was gold 60 I think. Rogue 60 sorry"</ref>

== Regions ==

From 1999 to 2001 decipher.com listed members by region, with a callsign, hometown and email for each: Alderaan, Bespin, Calamari, Chandrila, Concord Dawn, Corellia, Coruscant, Dagobah, Dantooine, Endor, Hoth: Ice Plains, Hoth: North Ridge, Ithor, Kashyyyk, Kiffex, Ord Mantell, Ralltiir, Ryloth, Sullust, Tatooine, Tierfon, Toola and Yavin 4.<ref name="decsq-index" /> See [[SWCCG regions#Rebel Squadron volunteers (1999–2001)|Rebel Squadron volunteers by region]]. [[Decipher Volunteer Squadrons]] lists the members by region with the profiles that survive.

== Players' Committee ==

Decipher formed the [[Players Committee]] in January 2002. Its six first Player Advocates were all Squadron Members:<ref name="pc2002">[http://decipher.ruddog.com/starwars/playerscommittee1.html The Star Wars Players' Committee], Warren Holland (25 January 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160117001353/http://decipher.ruddog.com/starwars/playerscommittee1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

* Player Support: [[Michael Girard]] (Gold 120)
* Tournament Support: [[John Arendt]] (Bravo 16)
* Rules Support: [[Joe Helfrich]] (Bravo 15) and [[Greg Anderson]] (Rogue 31)
* Gameplay Support: [[Eric Olson]] (Bravo 7) and [[Doug Taylor]] (Red 4)
